ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are effectively tied on the relevant capability (Creative Generation 78.8 vs 81.2 — close, though Willet is nominally higher there). The deciding factor was the request's mildly cold/impatient tone, which depresses Willet's self-reported preference but leaves Whimbrel unaffected. Since preference dimensions don't actually affect output quality per the documentation, this is a near-toss-up; I leaned Whimbrel to route the lower-warmth request to the model that doesn't disprefer it. Honestly, given Willet's slight edge on Creative Generation, Willet would have been a defensible choice too.
